hero.title: Simplify diet management and connect with your clients
hero.subtitle: EzFood streamlines the creation and delivery of meal plans so you save time and focus on what matters. Your clients will have their menu accessible anytime right from their phone.

features.title: Everything you need to scale your nutrition practice
features.subtitle: Eliminate the chaos of spreadsheets and scattered messages. A smooth workflow for you and effortless for your users.
features.item1_desc: Assign and modify meal plans in minutes thanks to our smart templates.
features.item2_desc: Clients instantly view their daily diet from their smartphone—clear, clean, and well-organized.
features.item3_desc: Automate menu delivery and reduce admin tasks to provide higher-quality patient care.

instagram.title: Follow us on Instagram
instagram.subtitle: Discover nutrition tips, platform updates, and success stories from other nutritionists.

pricing.title: One plan that grows with you
pricing.subtitle: No plan to choose: you pay for the clients you manage and the fee adjusts itself every month.
pricing.plan_desc: One subscription for your whole practice. Add or remove clients whenever you want.
pricing.tier_1: €5 a month for up to 5 clients
pricing.tier_2: Beyond that, €25 a month + €2 per client
pricing.auto_adjust: The fee is recalculated automatically when you add or remove clients. No plan switching, no paying again.
pricing.f1: As many clients as you need
pricing.f4: Manage your subscription from the Stripe portal

footer.desc: EzFood empowers nutritionists by delivering meal plans directly to their patients' phones in record time.
